item.description: Short sellers have targeted Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) over alleged connections to Chinese firms blacklisted by Washington, erasing more than 10 per cent off its value in a matter of hours and fuelling speculation over whether it could be the next chip company in the crosshairs after Nvidia. item.title: China didn’t just host an Apec summit. It ran a year-long campaign
item.description: The image everyone will remember from Shenzhen is three men in one frame – Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin, with Xi at the centre. item.title: Hong Kong joins global drug body ahead of schedule, boosting regulatory ambitions
item.description: Hong Kong has joined a global body for drug regulators ahead of schedule, a move health authorities say brings the city closer to establishing its own internationally recognised regulatory authority. The city was admitted as the 20th regulatory member of the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) at an assembly meeting in Prague on Tuesday.
